items.name: Bolt
items.description: A plain spark of force thrown at one enemy stack.

items.name: Mend
items.description: Closes the wounds of one of your stacks; the fallen stay fallen.

items.name: Sharpen
items.description: Puts an edge on one of your stacks' blows.

items.name: Quicken
items.description: Lightens the step of one of your stacks.

items.name: Shell
items.description: Hardens one of your stacks against the blows that come.

items.name: Steady
items.description: Holds the ranks of one of your stacks together.

items.name: Hobble
items.description: Drags at the feet of one enemy stack.

items.name: Daze
items.description: Clouds one enemy stack so that it moves after all others.

items.name: Snare
items.description: Binds one enemy stack where it stands.

items.name: Unweave
items.description: Picks apart the spells that help one enemy stack.

items.name: Cleanse
items.description: Washes what harms one of your stacks away.

items.name: Shift
items.description: Slides one of your stacks across the field without spending its turn.

items.name: Overdrive
items.description: Opens one stack's furnace valves: harder blows, paid for in its own health.

items.name: Stoke
items.description: Every blow one stack lands feeds the fire for the next.

items.name: Cooling Slag
items.description: Pours slag over one enemy stack's feet; it holds, then drags as it cools.

items.name: Ember Lash
items.description: A whip of embers that leaves heat in what it strikes.

items.name: Hot Iron
items.description: Sears one stack's wounds shut at once; nothing else can mend them for a while.

items.name: Rivet Plate
items.description: Rivets a plate of forged iron over one stack, taking blows until it breaks.

items.name: Heartwood Stance
items.description: One stack roots its stance and strikes hardest where it stands.

items.name: Grasping Roots
items.description: Roots seize one enemy stack and close tighter every turn it stays.

items.name: Pollen Drift
items.description: A drift of heavy pollen puts one enemy stack to sleep until something hits it.

items.name: Thornshot
items.description: A volley of thorns that bites deepest into a stack that cannot move.

items.name: Green Mending
items.description: Living growth knits one stack's wounds at the start of each of its turns.

items.name: Thornmail
items.description: Wraps one stack in thorns that cut whoever strikes it in melee.

items.name: Call to Arms
items.description: A signal flare that sends one stack forward to act next.

items.name: Sighting Mark
items.description: A bright mark on one enemy stack that every one of yours can aim for.

items.name: Dazzle
items.description: A flash that leaves one enemy stack unable to aim and swinging wild.

items.name: Radiant Mend
items.description: Clean light that heals one stack and burns away one harmful status.

items.name: Prism Ward
items.description: A prism around one stack turns the next harmful spell aside.

items.name: Hungering
items.description: One stack's blows feed it a share of what they take.

items.name: Dread
items.description: Whispers that shake one enemy stack and keep it from closing on yours.

items.name: Fog Mind
items.description: Fills one enemy stack's heads with fog; its blows fall on whoever stands near.

items.name: Wasting Curse
items.description: A curse that eats at one enemy stack each turn and seeks a new host if it falls.

items.name: Mist Cloak
items.description: Wraps one stack in mist that no archer can find.

items.name: Cinder Spray
items.description: A spray of cinders that burns the target and everything around it, friend or foe.

items.name: Spark Swarm
items.description: A swarm of sparks that scatters across the enemy line.

items.name: Dawn Lance
items.description: A lance of dawn light from your edge of the field through every enemy in its path.

items.name: Morning Light
items.description: Morning light falls on every stack of yours and closes its wounds.

items.name: Leech
items.description: Draws the life out of one enemy stack and pours half of it into one of yours.

items.name: Graft
items.description: Grafts two of your stacks together with living bark: a wound to one is shared by both.

items.name: Blood Tithe
items.description: Draws life from one of your stacks into another, enough to bring its fallen back.

items.name: Signal Swap
items.description: A flash of signal light, and two of your stacks stand in each other's places.

items.name: Changeling Swap
items.description: Mist folds an enemy stack and one of yours into each other's places.

items.name: Flame Furrow
items.description: A furrow of fire across the field: whatever walks through it or stands in it burns.

items.name: Bramble Patch
items.description: Brambles burst from the ground; a stack that blunders in is held there and torn.

items.name: Thorn Seed
items.description: A seed waits in the ground for the first enemy to stop beside it.

items.name: Crystal Pillar
items.description: A pillar of clear crystal rises from an empty hex and shelters your stacks beside it.

items.name: Murk
items.description: A bank of fog settles over a few hexes; nothing shoots into it or out of it.

items.name: Molten Edge
items.description: Pours molten metal along one stack's weapons; whatever they strike catches fire.

items.name: Cinderfall
items.description: Glowing cinders fall on one enemy stack and set it and its neighbours burning.

items.name: Flashpoint
items.description: Sets off all the heat a stack carries at once; a cold one only warms.

items.name: Annealing
items.description: Slow heat mends one stack and leaves it tougher.

items.name: Heavy Plating
items.description: Bolts thick plates onto one stack: hard to hurt, slow to move.

items.name: Tempering
items.description: Tempers one stack like steel: no single blow or spell takes more than a quarter of it.

items.name: Smelter's Bargain
items.description: One of your stacks feeds the furnace with its own blood, and the flame falls on an enemy stack.

items.name: Budding
items.description: New creatures bud from one stack's ranks; they wither when the battle ends.

items.name: Earthsplit
items.description: The ground splits under one enemy stack and throws it back a hex.

items.name: Bloomburst
items.description: A burst of blossom heals one stack and, more softly, the stacks beside it.

items.name: Seed of Return
items.description: Plants a seed in one stack: if it falls, it grows back once.

items.name: Bark Ring
items.description: A ring of bark closes around one stack and the stacks beside it.

items.name: Blight
items.description: Rots one enemy stack: nothing heals it again this battle, and healing burns it instead.

items.name: Volley Signal
items.description: A signal flare: every shooter of yours looses at the stack it marks and keeps its turn.

items.name: Prism Bolt
items.description: A bolt of split light strikes one enemy stack and leaps on, weaker each time.

items.name: Rekindle
items.description: Lights the fallen of one stack back to their feet.

items.name: Watchful Light
items.description: A light keeps watch over the field and mends whichever stack of yours is worst hurt each round.

items.name: Glass Aegis
items.description: A shell of clear glass: no enemy spell can be aimed at the stack inside.

items.name: Steadfast Halo
items.description: A steady light over one stack and its neighbours: nothing harries, staggers or roots them.

items.name: Hollowing
items.description: One of your stacks hollows out the enemies pressed against it and drinks what it takes.

items.name: Tolling Doom
items.description: A bell only one enemy stack can hear; on its second toll the doom falls.

items.name: Last Breath
items.description: One stack cannot lose its last creature for a while, then catches its breath.

items.name: Goad
items.description: Goads one enemy stack into a fury: stronger, but it must go for the stack of yours you name.

items.name: Uproot
items.description: Roots tear one enemy stack out of its place and drag it where you will, reeling.

items.name: Living Wall
items.description: Trees shoot up in a row across the field: nothing walks through them, and shots across them lose half their force.

items.name: Boundary Line
items.description: A line of light the enemy cannot step across.

items.name: Prism Array
items.description: A standing crystal that answers each of your hero's damage spells with a bolt of its own.

items.name: Fogwalk
items.description: Turns one stack to fog: it walks through anything, and its next blow comes from nowhere.

items.name: Night Terror
items.description: A waking nightmare: one enemy stack runs from your army and has no heart to strike back.

items.name: Bog Pool
items.description: The ground turns to sucking mire for the rest of the battle: slow to cross, and no footing to brace on.

items.name: Brass Sentinel
items.description: Builds a brass sentinel beside one of your stacks. It cannot move, but it strikes whatever comes next to it.

items.name: Wake the Grove
items.description: Treants rise beside one of your stacks, slow and sturdy, and fight for you for a few rounds.

items.name: Raise the Fallen
items.description: A stack destroyed in this battle, yours or the enemy's, rises and fights for you for a few rounds.

items.name: Decoy
items.description: A copy of one of your stacks stands beside it and draws the enemy's blows; it vanishes when anything hits it.

items.name: Hour Ledger
items.description: One of your stacks goes back to the creatures, health and hex it had at the start of an earlier round.

items.name: Puppet Strings
items.description: One enemy stack makes an attack now, at part of its strength, against a stack of its own side.

items.name: Molten Brand
items.description: Brands one enemy stack with molten iron; every hurt it takes melts its armour further.

items.name: Kiln Burst
items.description: A kiln bursts on one enemy stack and throws its fire over the stacks around it.

items.name: Crucible Ward
items.description: A crucible's heat takes the next wound meant for one of your stacks, and the stack strikes back hotter.

items.name: Spore Cloud
items.description: A cloud of spores sickens one enemy stack and those beside it; healing barely takes on them.

items.name: Thicket Snare
items.description: A thicket springs up around one hex and holds fast every enemy stack inside it.

items.name: Sapflood
items.description: Sap floods one stack's wounds, raises its fallen and keeps on healing it.

items.name: Ironbark
items.description: Bark like iron covers one stack; shots and spells glance off it.

items.name: Censure
items.description: A judgement of light falls on one enemy stack: its gifts fail and its own hero cannot help it.

items.name: Searing Ray
items.description: A searing ray burns one enemy stack, worst of all one already blinded.

items.name: Sanctuary
items.description: A ring of light keeps every hurt off one stack, which can only wait inside it.

items.name: Grave Edge
items.description: Grave-cold edges pass through any armour, blow after blow.

items.name: Stupor
items.description: A heavy stupor drops one enemy stack where it stands; it comes round harried.

items.name: Death's Door
items.description: Death knocks for one enemy stack; three turns later a share of it answers.

items.name: Full Steam
items.description: Every stack of yours runs hot: harder blows, quicker feet, and a first strike that sets its mark burning.

items.name: Molten Deluge
items.description: Molten iron rains on every enemy stack, heating each but never to bursting.

items.name: Iron Oath
items.description: Every stack of yours swears the oath of iron: a plate over it, and no stagger, root or stun can take hold.

items.name: Second Sun
items.description: A second sun climbs over the field and scorches every enemy stack as each round ends, for the rest of the battle.

items.name: Grasp of the Deep
items.description: Roots rise under every enemy stack; a stack already held is crushed still for a turn.

items.name: Spring Eternal
items.description: Every stack of yours regrows each turn for a while, and the fallen grow back with what is left over.

items.name: Lantern Vigil
items.description: Lanterns kindle over every stack of yours, mending wounds and lifting one harmful status from each.

items.name: Daybreak Charge
items.description: Every stack of yours rides with the dawn: harder and quicker, and all of them move before the enemy next round.

items.name: Dawn of Return
items.description: Dawn breaks over every stack of yours, healing it and bringing back its fallen with what is left over.

items.name: Eternal Noon
items.description: The sun stands still over your side: for some rounds your stacks act first and nothing blinds, roots, staggers or stuns them.

items.name: Fever Wind
items.description: A sick wind blows through every enemy stack, and the fever stays on after it.

items.name: Long Night
items.description: The long night falls on every enemy stack: each loses heart, and the smallest runs.

items.name: Black Tide
items.description: A black tide washes over every enemy stack and takes a share of each, never its last creature.

items.name: Redline
items.description: One of your stacks runs past the red line: it strikes twice on its next turn, and harder, then cannot strike back for a while.

items.name: Clarion Call
items.description: A clarion rings for one of your stacks: it takes another full turn straight after this one, and strikes harder.

items.name: Echo
items.description: The last spell your hero cast in this battle rings out again at once, stronger, and costs nothing more.

items.name: Shadow Ranks
items.description: Shadows stand in the ranks of one of your stacks: many of the creatures it loses come back as the round ends.

items.name: Elder Grove
items.description: An elder grove rises around one hex for the rest of the battle; your stacks in it heal and stand harder.

items.name: Glass Dome
items.description: A crystal dome closes over one hex and the six around it: no shot or spell from outside it hurts the stacks within.

items.name: Green Return
items.description: Once a battle, every stack of yours that has fallen grows back with a share of its starting creatures as the next round begins.

items.name: Foundry Golem
items.description: The foundry pours a brass golem onto an empty hex beside one of your stacks, to fight for you for a few rounds.

items.name: Clockwork Twin
items.description: Clockwork copies one of your stacks beside it, with a share of its creatures, to fight for a few rounds.

items.name: Waking Forest
items.description: An elder treant wakes beside your stacks, and trees grow around it for the rest of the battle.

items.name: Wraith Host
items.description: A host of wraiths falls on any empty hex you pick, in two flying stacks, to fight for you for a few rounds.

items.name: Drowned Host
items.description: Every stack destroyed in this battle, yours or the enemy's, rises from the deep as Risen to fight for you for a few rounds.

items.name: Hollow Crown
items.description: For the rest of the battle, every enemy stack destroyed rises for you as Risen as the next round begins.

items.name: Far Sight
items.description: The hero's eyes reach farther over the land for the rest of the day.

items.name: Stride
items.description: A long, tireless stride carries the army a few tiles farther today.

items.name: Read Tracks
items.description: Tracks and trampled ground tell the hero what holds the towns nearby.

items.name: Watchtower Lens
items.description: A lens of light shows the hero the land far around, and the deep ground beneath it.

items.name: Harvest Bloom
items.description: The mine beside the hero blooms with ore and yields double for days.

items.name: Forge Road
items.description: Heat runs ahead of the hero along the roads; the army marches them at twice the pace.

items.name: Scorched Earth
items.description: The ground around the hero smoulders; enemy armies wade through it at half the pace.

items.name: Wardwood
items.description: A watchful tree springs up where the hero stands and holds back enemy armies that come near it.

items.name: Flare
items.description: A bright flare bursts over far ground and lights it for the hero's scouts.

items.name: Firebreak
items.description: A wall of fire rises beside the hero; no army gets through while it burns.

items.name: Rootway
items.description: The roots under the woods carry the army to trees farther off.

items.name: Relay
items.description: A beacon lit in one of the hero's towns calls the army home in a flash of light.

items.name: Ferry Call
items.description: A ferry of mist carries the army over the water to the far shore.

items.name: Mist Jump
items.description: The army steps into the mist and out of it a few tiles away, past any guard.

items.name: Green Path
items.description: Branches part and stones settle before the hero; the army crosses forest and rough ground as easily as open grass.

items.name: Mire Stride
items.description: A grey film hardens under the army's feet; it walks swamp, mire and sand as if they were meadow.
